messages:
Alex K: FYI — a new customer hit a 401 during onboarding. They followed the README curl and got back 'insufficient_scope'.
Maria S: Which sample/app? can you paste the exact curl they ran?
Alex K: Pasted from README under 'quickstart -> make a request':
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-1","input":"Hello"}'
```
This is what they copied. The error shows up after their CI rotates a token mid-run.
Jordan P: Got it — two things: (1) our README doesn't call out required key scopes (we recently added 'inference.write' and 'inference.read'), and (2) the Python snippet doesn't show how to enable retries/refresh, while Node example has a built-in retry note. SDK parity gap.
Sam Q: I reproduced it in a smoke test: when token is rotated, the API responds with 401 + body `{"error":"insufficient_scope"}`. Logs: `auth: token valid but missing scope inference.write`.
Alex K: Proposed README quick fix to avoid copy/paste footgun — add a short note and an example curl with explicit guidance: 
```
# Ensure your API key includes the inference.write scope (see console)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-1","input":"Hello"}'
```
And a tiny paragraph: "If you get a 401 with 'insufficient_scope', check that your key has the 'inference.write' permission or use a service token with appropriate scopes."
Maria S: Also suggest adding an example of configuring retries/refresh for long-lived jobs (so people who copy sample app won't crash when tokens rotate). Could be a single-line note pointing to the SDK retry docs.
Jordan P: I'll add a Python snippet we can put under "advanced: retries":
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util import Retry

retry_strategy = Retry(total=5, backoff_factor=0.3, status_forcelist=[429,500,502,503,504])
adapter = HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry_strategy)
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
# mount adapter to session inside SDK or show how to set client.retry config
```
Sam Q: small QA note: also the sample app env var name differs from docs (sample app expects REDWOOD_KEY while README uses REDWOOD_API_KEY). That copy/paste mismatch is probably the root cause for several new users.
Docs CI Bot: docs-ci: running spellcheck + linkcheck for PR #1234 :eyes:
Maria S: I'll open a PR to (1) add the scope troubleshooting note, (2) add the python retry snippet, and (3) fix env var name in sample app. tagging @Jordan P for the snippet review.
Alex K: Thanks — please also add a one-line changelog in the README for future readers so this doesn't regress. :thumbsup:
